Source approval: no concrete ambiguity, role, or purpose regressions found in the current diff.

The exclusion is symmetric and limited to identical leaf names. Provider identity/role checks and earlier purpose-evidence and collision guards remain intact. The added test covers explicit policy context, missing context, and both-parent context.

Minor coverage gap: the positive assertion checks only `kind === "leaf"`, not the selected schema path.

Read-only source review only. The 338 passes and pinned Bot Defense result are supplied evidence; I did not rerun qualification.
